title: sida rivularis
intro: Sida rivularis, commonly known as the heart-leaved sida or heart-shaped sida, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Sida rivularis include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
